environment: Isolated Compose PostgreSQL 16 Alpine, local disposable database; gateway candidate code and matching migrations

scenarios.name: reservation uniqueness under concurrent budget contention
scenarios.evidence: one of two reservations admitted; usage plus reservations stayed within budget

scenarios.name: audit transaction rollback
scenarios.evidence: injected attempt failure left zero request and attempt rows

scenarios.name: settlement audit rollback
scenarios.evidence: injected failure left reservation reserved and zero receipt/request rows

scenarios.name: commit acknowledgement lost after a real commit
scenarios.evidence: wrapper raised after real finalize_stream returned; receipt query recovered settled state; replay idempotent; 10 tokens counted once; one request row

scenarios.name: concurrent idempotent finalization
scenarios.evidence: two concurrent calls both observed settled; one replay; one request row

scenarios.name: expired reservation reconciliation
scenarios.evidence: one expired reservation released with orphaned_released audit and release receipt

scenarios.name: network-level COMMIT sent then PostgreSQL ACK dropped
scenarios.evidence: no TCP fault proxy was used; synthetic wrapper is not equivalent

scenarios.name: process kill between server COMMIT and app receipt handling
scenarios.evidence: no process-kill interposition at commit boundary

scenarios.name: cross-replica duplicate request and concurrent reconciliation race

interpretation: The transaction and idempotency behaviors were exercised on PostgreSQL, but true transport-level commit-unknown and crash-boundary behavior remain unproven. Do not claim exactly-once delivery.
